meeting_point: at the Samuel Adams Statue in front of Faneuil Hall.
location_address: Samuel Adams Statue in front of Faneuil Hall Boston, MA US 02109
accessibility: mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines. Stroller and wheelchair accessible.
description:
Explore the life and influence of patriot Samuel Adams. The Man of the Revolution, Samuel Adams was also a man of contradictions. On this tour, visit historic colonial sites as you learn about Samuel Adams' early business failures, his genius in the run-up to Revolution, his descent into obscurity in the new republic, and why only his enemies called him "Sam."

After this special tour experience, raise a glass and show your support for Boston By Foot! Included in the price of your ticket is the choice between a souvenir Sam Adams tasting glass to take home with you, or a free drink at the Sam Adams Downtown Boston Taproom - first round is on Sam! (Over age 21 I.D. must be presented to the Taproom to redeem alcoholic beverages. Non-alcoholic soda options also available). BBF members receive a discounted ticket price.

This tour is presented in part thanks to the generous support of The Boston Beer Company.

what_is_included_items.value: Guided 60 minute outdoor tour exploring Boston's urban landscape
0.65 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
